Nadia, I've posted the list in the #strategic-pod thread. In short, I found 7 Vantorre Group tickets (Mobility excluded). Each one has its source in the thread:

- **#8841** appears three times with conflicting details. It's "closed" in July (pod channel), "open" at Allentown in May (2026-05-04 digest), and "submitted" from Newark in September (2026-09-30 digest). Someone should check the ticket system before the steering committee.
- **PD-8841** (2026-04-27 digest) may be the same ticket as #8841. The digests don't confirm it.
- **INC-4821** and **VT-55120** are in the Hartford war room (Hartford kiosk outage).
- **PD-4418** is in the 2025-09-15 digest. That digest says only "the account Nadia runs," so the Vantorre attribution is my inference.

I excluded #4812 and the Vantorre Mobility items.
